name: component-consulting-v3
description: Page-as-text component consultant with a real vendored corpus. Treats one loaded HTML page as one complete piece of writing: derives WHO reads it, WHAT genre it is, and HOW to compose it (Reader → Genre → Beats), then fills each beat from a 4,200+ open-source component corpus with actual code (uiverse, smoothui, magicui, tailark — MIT, commit-pinned, author-attributed) via deterministic retrieval. No live-scan sourcing, no model-memory stubs: every STUB is copied from a corpus code_path. Ships blocking gates (license, density floor, slop bans, prescription completeness) and emits a Render QA hand-off contract consumed by the render-audit skill. Supersedes component-consulting v1/v2. Design.md posture: consumes.
